name: damira
description: CCIE-level network operations — troubleshooting, upgrade planning, config audit, and device configuration for Cisco, Juniper, Arista, Palo Alto, and Fortinet

api_key.title: Damira API key
api_key.description: From damiraai.com > Dashboard > API Keys. Leave blank to try Damira on the shared demo key (50 queries/day).

execution_mode.title: Execution mode
execution_mode.description: advisor recommends commands for you to run and never touches a device. guided and lab allow Damira to run read-only show commands itself. Leave on advisor unless you are working in a lab.
